Name: Annas
Summary: Annas was the former high priest and father-in-law of Caiaphas, still powerful enough that Jesus was first taken to him on the night of the arrest, and he sat among those who examined Peter and John after Pentecost.
KeyStory: Jesus was led first to Annas, who questioned Him before sending Him bound to Caiaphas.
RelatedPeople: Caiaphas; Simon Peter; John the Apostle
LifeLesson: Power that has passed can still do harm. Annas shows how influence lingers long after office ends.
